notes.title: Experience an Epic Journey with Mythica Adventures!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Are you an adventure-seeker looking for your next quest? Look no further! [/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Mythica Adventures is a 2D platformer game designed by Bad Kong Games to immerse you in a thrilling and vibrant world. 

We’re taking it to Kickstarter to give backers the opportunity to join us and make this project come alive. We've got some awesome rewards in store for our backers, including early access to the game, exclusive in-game items, and more.  [/b][/h3]

[h3][b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/292958978/mythica-adventures-2d-platformer-game/description]JOIN US TODAY[/url][/b][/h3]
